Beer, bands and a good cause: Rock by the Sea returns to Sharonville

by CityBeat Staff October 23, 2026October 23, 2026

Share this:

A Sharonville-based brewery is once again hosting a music festival for charity.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:58
Instaread

Third Eye Brewing, located at 11276 Chester Road, is hosting the Rock by the Sea festival Oct. 23-25. The festival is in its 20th year and has raised over $1 million for charitable organizations.

Get our weekly events newsletter!

Get a roundup of weekend events right to your inbox every Thursday!

The lineup features Steve Everett, Rob Fetters, Green Light Morning, Jabtune (Lady Bri & Jon Bryant), Joe Jordan, Tony Lucca, Danni Nicholls, Jared Mahone and Noah Smith. Proceeds from the event will go to the Live Like Maya Foundation.

Based in Mason, the Live Like Maya Foundation funds pediatric cancer research and provides financial assistance to families of children battling cancer. It was named the 2025 Mason Deerfield Chamber of Commerce Nonprofit of the Year. Rock By The Sea, meanwhile, is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that organizes music festivals and events to assist deserving charities providing direct services to those in need.

For more information, including how to buy tickets, visit the event’s official website.
